title: The Present member of the club
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：present　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 present 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the clerk wrote of ① a present member of the club in the file, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so present that nobody in the office would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the clerk, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the present ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the present member of the club that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file for May 1959 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too present to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the applicant who had come to help; the present ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a present owner of the mill, and said that no applicant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as present as the owner of the mill they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was present or not, and he said so.

By 1972 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was ⑦ something present, and nothing besides. The applicant from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite present; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the file kept the names of the present ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1975, in the rain, she wrote of another present member of the club in the same file, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less present than anybody had expected. ⑩ The present owner of the mill that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1977, was the one she could never quite name; the present ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 出席（前置定语 a present member of the club：1965 年书记员在卷宗里记下的那件出席的俱乐部成员）
B. adj. 出席／现任（两处加强说法：so present that … 与 no less present than …）
C. adj. 出席／现任（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 出席（表语 too present to do：母亲觉得它太出席，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 现任（前置定语 a present owner of the mill：叔叔把整件事称作一桩现任的东家）
F. adj. 现任（同级比较 as present as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩磨坊现任的东家相比）
G. adj. 现任（后置定语 something present：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 现任（受程度副词修饰 quite present：那位申请人的评价）

items.q: a present member of the club
the present member of the club that
a present owner of the mill
The present owner of the mill that

answers.why: present 意为“出席”，1965 年书记员在卷宗里记下的是“一件出席的俱乐部成员”，此处作前置定语 a present member of the club。
present 意为“出席”，此处用 so present that 结构，说它出席到办事处里没人敢靠近。
present 意为“出席”，卷宗上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的出席到场的俱乐部成员，等于最高级的说法。
present 意为“出席”，母亲认为这件东西“太出席了，谁也用不上”，too present to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
present 意为“现任”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩现任的东家”，此处作前置定语 a present owner of the mill。
present 意为“现任”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩磨坊现任的东家一样现任”，同级比较用 as present as。
present 意为“现任”，卷宗上那半行字要的是“现任的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something present。
present 意为“现任”，邻办事处来的那位申请人认为这套计划“相当现任”，quite 修饰原级 present。
present 意为“现任”，no less present than 表示“其现任不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之现任不亚于任何人的预料。
present 意为“现任”，母亲 1977 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的现任东家”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，书记员在卷宗里记下了一件出席的俱乐部成员。（a present member of the club）
它出席到办事处里没有一个人敢靠近。（so present that …）
母亲觉得它太出席，谁也用不上。（too present to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩现任的东家。（a present owner of the mill）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩磨坊现任的东家一样现任。（as present as …）
到了 1972 年，卷宗上只剩半行字：要的是一件现任的东西。（something present）
answers: In 1965 the clerk wrote of a present member of the club in the file.
It was so present that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too present to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a present owner of the mill.
He said nobody would call it as present as the owner of the mill they had once had.
By 1972 the file asked for nothing but something present.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 present 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the clerk wrote of a present member of the club in the file, and nobody forgot it.
It was the present member of the club that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file says.
My mother thought it too present to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a present owner of the mill, and nobody argued with him.
The applicant from the next office called the plan quite present, and everybody laughed.
The present ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
